 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The LPGA Tour makes the final stop of its second Asian swing at the Taiheiyo Club, where the Toto Classic Japan is set to tee off this week and feature a limited, 78-player field.
 Japanese native Nasa Hataoka enters as the defending champion having won in a playoff after a final-round washout .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Jeeno Thitikul is the favorite to win for a fifth time this year and comes in surprisingly motivated, trailing in Miyu Yamashita in CME Globe points after the latter's victory at the Maybank Championship in Malaysia over the weekend.
 Yamashita, a three-time LPGA winner in 2026 and Japanese native, is primed to get a boost from playing in front of her country's fans after a sizzling second half to her season.
 Golf Channel will carry live action until the conclusion of the final round during the overnight hours of Saturday, Nov. 7, and Sunday, Nov. 8. Tee times and live scoring can be found on GolfChannel.com.
 Here's all of the information on how to watch the tournament on TV and links to stream the event (all times listed are ET).
